description: Plan trips by SL public transport between two stops or street addresses, leaving or arriving at a given time. Returns up to 3 trips, plus walking all the way when that takes at most 30 min. Each ride lists line, direction, platform, stops, crowding and delay; each walk lists minutes and the station exit (uppgång). Use it for 'how do I get to X' and 'when must I leave'; for departures from one stop, use get_departures. Addresses are fuzzy matched, so the result starts with what each one matched. Times are Stockholm time. Unknown stops, the same stop twice and times outside the timetable give a clear error. SL cannot plan step-free trips: for a wheelchair or pram, use prefer 'least walking' and check get_disruptions for broken lifts at the stops.

arriveBy.description: true: arrive by `time`. false: leave at `time`.

from.description: Start: a stop id from find_stop, or a street address like 'Götgatan 76, Stockholm'

modes.description: Only these modes, e.g. ['boat'] for 'by boat'. Leave out for all.

prefer.description: What to optimise for: fastest (default), fewest changes or least walking

time.description: Stockholm time as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM. Leave out to leave now.

to.description: Destination: a stop id from find_stop, or a street address

name: plan_trip
title: Plan trip
